name: deep gnome (svirfneblin)
lore:
In the deepest, darkest reaches of the Underdark, where the sun is a forgotten myth and the earth groans under the weight of ages, dwell the svirfneblin, the deep gnomes. Unlike their sun-kissed surface kin, these gnomes are carved from the very stone they inhabit, their spirits as weathered and enduring as the caverns they call home. The svirfneblin are a people of few smiles and many secrets, their lives a tapestry woven from the threads of caution, resilience, and an unwavering dedication to their hidden communities. 

Imagine a subterranean realm where every shadow dances with potential danger, where the softest whisper can echo through the tunnels, alerting unseen foes. Here, the svirfneblin carve out a meager existence, their days spent mining precious gems and fortifying their homes against the horrors that lurk in the darkness. Their faces, etched with the harsh realities of their world, betray a stoicism that belies a deep-seated love for their kin and an unyielding commitment to preserving their ancient ways.
